==Ingredients==
* 1 can (6 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) water-packed [[cookbook:Tuna|tuna]], drained and flaked
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] finely-[[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Celery|celery]]
* ¼ cup finely-chopped [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Bread|hamburger buns]], split
* 4 [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]] [[Cookbook:Slicing|slices]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]] slices
* 4 [[Cookbook:Lettuce|lettuce leaves]]

==Procedure==
# Preheat oven to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|350°F]].
# In a small bowl, combine tuna, celery, onion and mayonnaise.
# Spread on bottom of buns.
# Top tuna mixture with a slice of cheese and tomato.
# Place on an ungreased [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]].
# [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] for 12–15 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted.
# Top each with a lettuce leaf; replace bun tops.
